title: extract and locate underflow when the first sequence start is not 0 or there are no sequences
body:
`extract` (`libsufr/src/sufr_file.rs:990`) and `locate` (`:1234`) find the sequence of a suffix with `seq_starts.partition_point(|&val| val <= suffix) - 1`. If the first start is greater than 0, or `seq_starts` is empty, `partition_point` returns 0 for an early suffix and the subtraction underflows `usize`. That panics in a debug build and wraps in a release build. Both sites also clone `sequence_starts` and `sequence_names` first.

Seen by reading the code in the survey. No input that triggers it was found or run.
close_reason: Unreachable: read_sequence_file records the first record's start as 0 and an input with no records fails to build. Closed by Jack on 2026-11-03.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4be42394
notes.text:
At cff9fb6 both sites are `partition_point(|&val| val <= suffix) - 1`, at `search.rs:309` (`locate`) and `search.rs:350` (`extraction`). The clones are gone.

No input under `data/` triggers it. It needs a file whose first sequence start is above 0, or one with no sequences.

notes.author: Jeb Rosen/f3787cc2
notes.text: The same holds on dev at 657e16d: the `partition_point - 1` sites are `sufr_file.rs:980` (extract) and `:1226` (locate), and `read_sequence_file` in `util.rs` records the first start as 0.
